title: Warm Silky Tunisian Chicken Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Tunisian dish featuring chicken, thai chilli jam, and a silky sauce, all prepared with Buddhist temple friendly ingredients and cooking methods, including mushimono steam
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes
Add the thai chilli jam, chicken broth, honey, dried apricots, and sliced almonds to the pot
Stir everything together, then bring the mixture to a boil
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer, using mushimono steam, for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste, then serve it warm, garnished with fresh herbs and additional sliced almonds if desired
